cosine distance < 0.35

served by playbooks_category_status_precursor_idx

div.style: color: rgb(33, 11, 74) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Why not argmax?
argmax is a leaderboard. A leaderboard means a newborn
playbook is never selected, never gathers evidence,
and dies by TTL. A zero-trial challenger with a flat prior
beats a 0.9 incumbent's draw roughly one time in ten.

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
evolution_log('competition')
every draw is written — winners and losers —
so the competition is inspectable, not asserted

span.p:
SHADOW · mean < 0.75
record what would have run
execute nothing · trial weight 0.30

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
AUTO · reversible
execute now — Guardian can undo it

write an approvals row and wait
rotate_certificate · prune_disk
